theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible, one-narrative leader with the strongest durability_bar (0.61) and is not crowded, so the absolute-trend gate supports staying with the dominant theme while it remains above trend. Its leadership is confirmed, not a next-theme guess; conviction is calibrated to a strong past track record (hit rate 0.966, dir accuracy 0.931 on n=29) but cap at medium because the scorable proxy is unavailable and rank momentum itself has no alpha.
theses.dissent: Banks is not scorable here (no ETF proxy) and its r10 is slightly negative (-0.0055); a mixed hurst_tag and narrow breadth mean leadership could stall without a trend continuation leg; the high macro unscheduled surprise share (1.0) means a policy/geo shock could rotate money elsewhere quickly.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false) before the 45-day check-by.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the weakest scorable theme in the set (rank 13, score -0.815, eligible=false) and sits deep in the laggard tail, so the absolute-trend gate argues for staying out while it fails the trend filter. The lean is avoid (not a short) and conviction is low because momentum rank is not a return forecast and this is one of only two scorable names.
theses.dissent: The theme is deeply oversold (crowding_z -0.94) and China Tech has historically mean-reverted from a laggard tail; the gate avoids drawdown but gives no edge on when it re-eligibles, so an avoid could lag a sharp rebound.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) crosses back to eligible=true and holds above-trend for 10 consecutive sessions before the 30-day check-by.
